Transforms an instance of SensorHealthAlert to achieve the following:
When a sensor in SensorOperationalStatusEnum#FAULTY status has an existing SensorOperationalStatusTimedValue#endDate,
a new endDateWithPrefix field is created by concatenating the locally formatted date with a translated prefix.
If there is any Sensor without an Sensor#operationalStatus, add a default value so that they are treated as
SensorOperationalStatusEnum#OPERATIONAL in the UI.
Creates a new valueIconMap field to assign the appropriate icon to the sensor's SensorOperationalStatusTimedValue#status.
This assignment is based on its translation field SensorOperationalStatusTimedValue#translatedStatus.
Example:
For a sensor in operational status (in English): { Operational: 'check-circle' }
For a sensor in faulty status (in English): { Faulty: 'exclamation-triangle' }
